description: This file defines a static helper class 'TokenCredentialHelper' to facilitate creation of Azure service clients (Table and Queue) with appropriate credentials, including support for local emulators and various credential types based on environment variables.

classes.name: TokenCredentialHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods to create Azure service clients with appropriate credentials and tokens, supporting emulated storage and environment-based credential selection.

methods.name: CreateTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates an Azure TableServiceClient, using an emulator connection string when the URI is localhost.

methods.name: CreateQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Creates an Azure QueueServiceClient, using an emulator connection string when the URI is localhost.

methods.name: GetTokenCredential
methods.description: Returns a TokenCredential based on environment variables, supporting federated credentials and default Azure credentials.

methods.name: GetManagedIdentityToken
methods.description: Fetches an access token for a Managed Identity given its client ID and audience.
